conventions.sweep_cumulative: angle between the spanwise vertical through the root reference point and the line from it to the same reference point at that station, positive aft
conventions.rake: leading-edge offset out of the planform plane, +Z
conventions.dihedral: same construction as the sweep but on the rake, positive toward +Z; the wing name for propeller rake angle
conventions.twist: angle of the section chord line, positive nose-up
conventions.shape_parameters: normalised by the local chord, measured in the section's own chord-aligned frame so twist does not leak into thickness or camber
conventions.tolerances: decide only how a distribution is labelled; the tabulated values are the raw measurements

columns.name: chord
columns.description: true LE->TE length in the section plane

columns.name: sweep_le
columns.description: cumulative LE sweep from the root LE, positive aft

columns.name: rake
columns.description: LE offset out of the planform plane (propeller rake)

columns.name: dihedral
columns.description: cumulative dihedral / rake angle, positive toward +Z

columns.name: twist
columns.description: section twist / pitch angle, positive nose-up

columns.name: x_cmax
columns.description: x/c of maximum camber, NaN on a symmetric section

summary.note: integrals cover the extracted span only, root up to the top station; nothing above it is included
